summary: Implemented validated request and W3C trace context using AsyncLocalStorage, canonical correlation response headers, newline-delimited structured request-completion logs, defensive recursive redaction for credentials/PII/tokens, safe error serialization, bounded metadata, and sink-failure isolation. Integrated observability before the security boundary so security error envelopes share the canonical request ID. No product route was added; /health and /ready retain their existing bodies and semantics.
